w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (Ugly-Eyes, The Redactor, Chorus Line, The Loud Beast) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! The palisade's stakes take their toll as they come over the wall.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Owen. Gavel, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Focus Group is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Chorus Line.

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Callback.

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: A frame of it hangs in the air. Then another. It's buffering.

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 💥 tiger's Rerun finds Everett — no dodging it.
firstContext: Too close. The tiger's attention SNAPS to Everett — proximity overrules patience.
💥 tiger's Rerun finds Everett — no dodging it.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: The trial window closed. The audience makes a disappointed sound, like wind.
📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 25 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
★ IDENTIFIED: Sweet Manioc. Manioc. Tall stalks, hand-shaped leaves, thick roots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
SYSTEM: Identification complete. You are 0.3% less lost.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (22/10/7), with 7 wave-4 fought, 6 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 18 · Craft 11 · Talk 14 · Explore 35 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TOTAL — COLD, CLEAN, EFFICIENT. YOU WOULD MAKE A MAGNIFICENT MACHINE. I MEAN THAT AS THE HIGHEST COMPLIMENT AND SLIGHTLY AS A THREAT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept; the relay carried faithfully. The dark road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Merge fully. No way back."

◈ Henrik Lien reached into the light and the light reached back — person and machine, two caretakers, holding the channel open between them both ways. The village endures, and the conversation does not end.
